title.narrative: European School in Georgia

description.narrative: UNOPS will be entrusted to implement the phase II of the action The European School in Georgia which promotes high quality international education in the Eastern Neighbourhood. Its specific objective is to establish a European School in Tbilisi to provide secondary level education to students from all six Eastern neighbours countries and offer a European-focused learning programme that promotes European values of multiculturalism and multilingualism.
